quizData.question: Why would you use an `AbortController` in a data‑fetching composable?

options.text: To cancel an in‑progress request when a new one starts or the component unmounts

quizData.explanation: AbortController allows you to cancel fetch requests, which prevents race conditions and wasted network resources when components unmount or new requests are made.
